mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) above 2% YoY signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) below 100,000 new jobs signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) above 1.5 million units signals strong housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals accommodative monetary policy in an inflationary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) below 2% YoY signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
